description: CloudSecurityFramework is the Schema for the CloudSecurityFramework API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: CloudSecurityFrameworkSpec defines the desired state of CloudSecurityFramework

category.description: Optional. The category of the framework.

cloudControlDetails.description: Optional. The cloud control details that are directly added without any grouping in the framework.

cloudControlRef.description: Required. The name of the CloudControl in the format: “organizations/{organization}/locations/{location}/ cloudControls/{cloud-control}”

external.description: A reference to an externally managed CloudSecurityComplianceCloudControl resource. Should be in the format "organizations/{{organizationID}}/locations/{{location}}/cloudControls/{{cloudControlID}}".

name.description: The name of a CloudSecurityComplianceCloudControl resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a CloudSecurityComplianceCloudControl resource.

parameters.description: Optional. Parameters is a key-value pair that is required by the CloudControl. The specification of these parameters will be present in cloudcontrol.Eg: { "name": "location","value": "us-west-1"}.

name.description: Required. The name or key of the parameter.

parameterValue.description: Required. The value of the parameter.

description.description: Optional. The description of the framework. The maximum length is 2000 characters.

displayName.description: Optional. The friendly name of the framework. The maximum length is 200 characters.

labels.description: Optional. The labels with user-defined metadata to organize your frameworks.

organizationRef.description: The organization that this resource belongs to. Only one of organizationRef or projectRef may be specified.

external.description: The 'name' field of an organization, when not managed by Config Connector.

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Only one of organizationRef or projectRef may be specified.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

resourceID.description: Optional. The CloudSecurityFramework name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

x-kubernetes-validations.message: Exactly one parent field must be set

status.description: CloudSecurityFrameworkStatus defines the config connector machine state of CloudSecurityFramework

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the CloudSecurityFramework resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

majorRevisionID.description: Output only. The major version of the framework, which is incremented in ascending order.

supportedCloudProviders.description: Output only. The cloud providers that are supported by the framework.

supportedEnforcementModes.description: Output only. The supported enforcement modes of the framework.

supportedTargetResourceTypes.description: Output only. The target resource types that are supported by the framework.

type.description: Output only. The type of framework.
